name: kzarzycki-agent-skills
description: Krzysztof Zarzycki's agent skills — workflow, research, engineering, presales toolkits for Claude Code

plugins.name: workflow
plugins.description: Persistent workspace, agent orchestration, session search, learning consolidation, and HTML-based user communication. Includes flow (.work/ workspaces), orchestrator (read-only main thread), find-conversation (CC session search), communicating-in-html (optional enrichment that renders reports, interviews, and option/mockup choices as self-contained HTML instead of Markdown), and the /promote-learnings command.

plugins.name: research
plugins.description: Multi-source deep research orchestration plus platform-specific knowledge (Perplexity, Tavily, Exa, Gemini, ChatGPT, Claude.ai).

plugins.name: engineering
plugins.description: Developer toolkit: third-party software safety audit and project context extraction into CLAUDE.md.

plugins.name: content
plugins.description: Content preparation. voice-dna extracts an 8-dimension writing-style profile from a person's LinkedIn posts, for stakeholder prep, content writing, or proposal personalization.

plugins.name: google-workspace
plugins.description: Google Workspace skills sourced directly from github.com/googleworkspace/cli (no local copy — tracks upstream). 109 skills across Gmail, Drive, Calendar, Sheets, Docs, Slides, Tasks, Chat, Meet, Forms, Keep, plus personas and recipes. Every skill shells out to the locally installed `gws` binary; requires `gws` installed and authenticated (`brew install googleworkspace-cli`).

plugins.name: mattpocock-skills
plugins.description: Matt Pocock's Skills for Real Engineers. Adds small composable engineering and productivity skills including diagnose, grill-with-docs, tdd, to-prd, to-issues, zoom-out, prototype, caveman, grill-me, handoff, and write-a-skill. Source is loaded directly from upstream; no local copy is vendored here.
